title: hydrangea × agricola
intro: Hydrangea × agricola, commonly known as Bigleaf Hydrangea, is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of the Appalachian Mountains. The plant's roots and leaves have been used in traditional medicine for their potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving arthritis pain, and acting as an antispasmodic to soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Hydrangea × agricola include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and tannins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's roots have been traditionally used to treat urinary issues and may help to relieve symptoms of anxiety and insomnia due to its calming effects.
